supported_scope: Workspace and directory rules (AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, .agents/rules/*.md), global rules under ~/.gemini and ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/rules/, and plugin rules, evaluated during prompt expansion. Rules are cumulative; more specific directory rules take priority. Frontmatter triggers: always_on, model_decision, glob, manual.
unestablished_scope: Whether rules are guaranteed to be followed (documented as injected context, not enforcement)
required_setup: Create a rules file; none exists by default.
constraints: 20,000-token aggregate budget; larger rules are demoted to pointers

evidence.section: Antigravity CLI > Managing rules in Antigravity CLI
evidence.quote: The Antigravity CLI evaluates workspace, directory-scoped, global, and plugin rules during prompt expansion
Rules are cumulative rather than replacement-based
Antigravity truncates any single rule file that exceeds 24,000 bytes
